pinConvention: Proposed stable Pages project UUIDs identify each environment; approved executor must use exactly the same public deployment identity. This convention has not been applied or adopted by a live executor.
slots: Apply to every enabled TRAINING slot only after fresh metadata reconciliation; preview enablement is currently unknown.

publicVerifier.required: Approved external signer public RSA JWK array; unique kid; minimum 2048-bit key; no private components; import/verification and signer fingerprint must be independently checked.

ownerException.required: Identify the existing approved external executor/custodian and supply only its public JWK and nonsecret runner/provider reference. If none exists, explicitly authorize establishing TRAINING-only external signer/provider custody before implementation or key/credential creation.
ownerException.syntheticIdentity: Dedicated individually authenticated TRAINING test identity is not yet corroborated; never reuse Owner or employee credentials.
ownerException.permissions: Any new provider credential or Access authority requires a separate scoped security decision. Existing metadata token read success does not demonstrate mutation/deployment/revocation permissions.

releasePrerequisites: Fresh corroboration of TRAINING project/D1/AUD, historical peer project identity and absence of forbidden credentials in all enabled slots.
Approved signer/executor custody, exact public-key material and individual admission/revocation mechanism that preserves Owner/service policies.
Existing protected TRAINING configuration/deployment approval; no automatic approval, bypass or old-run reuse.
Target-specific release from the reviewed application SHA; never deploy using unchanged production-pinned root wrangler.toml.
Verify actual deployed SHA, project/database bindings and loaded public variables before any synthetic fixture/login.
Prepare exact synthetic fixture IDs, role/scope and governed request/receipt; independently authenticate individual subject before Step19 release.
